title: Feta & Sun-Dried Tomato Savoury Cake
description: A moist, golden savoury loaf studded with crumbled feta, jammy sun-dried tomatoes and black olives. Equally good warm from the oven, at room temperature, or sliced cold the next day.

ingredients.name: Neutral oil (sunflower or mild olive oil)
Sun-dried tomatoes in oil, drained and roughly chopped

steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C (fan). Butter and flour a standard loaf tin (about 25 × 10 cm), or line it with baking paper.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk and oil until combined.
Sift in the flour and baking powder and fold until just combined — do not overmix.
Fold in the crumbled feta, sun-dried tomatoes, olives, basil and black pepper. Taste before adding salt — feta and olives are already salty.
Pour the batter into the prepared tin and smooth the top. Bake for 40-45 minutes until a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean and the top is deep golden.
Leave to cool in the tin for 10 minutes before turning out. Serve warm or at room temperature.
footnote: Sun-dried tomatoes in oil give a softer, jammier result than the dry-packed kind. Pat them dry before chopping to keep the crumb from becoming greasy. The cake keeps well wrapped for 2 days at room temperature, or up to 4 days in the fridge.
